blocks.heading: Career Options After 12th PCM
rows: Rung 1. Computer science at the oldest IITs (Bombay, Delhi, Madras, Kanpur, Kharagpur)
JEE Advanced rank
JoSAA 2026, round 5 (the final round), open gender-neutral: Bombay 67, Delhi 128, Madras 151, Kanpur 283, Kharagpur 509.
Branch-wise seat counts were not collected. All IIT seats together: 18,951. 56,880 students qualified for Advanced.
NIRF 2025 median pay of the placed: IIT Madras Rs 17.5 lakh, IIT Delhi Rs 19.08 lakh.
About one in five IIT Delhi graduates was neither placed nor in higher studies (NIRF 2025).
Rung 2. Computer science at Roorkee, Hyderabad, Guwahati, BHU and Indore
JEE Advanced rank
Same round: Roorkee 587, Hyderabad 680, Guwahati 822, BHU 1,439, Indore 1,676.
Same 18,951 IIT seats, with closing ranks about 9 to 25 times looser than Bombay.
We did not read the NIRF sheets for these five. Open each one before you compare.
A rank of about 1,500 reaches BHU or Indore computer science, not Delhi.
Rung 3. Core branches (Mechanical, Civil, Electrical) at the old IITs
JEE Advanced rank

JoSAA 2025, final round: Mechanical closed at 1,766 (Bombay), 2,354 (Madras), 3,599 (Kharagpur). Civil at 4,095 (Bombay) and 5,629 (Madras). Electrical at 418 (Bombay) and 741 (Madras). 2026 core-branch ranks were not collected, so these are last year.
Same IIT seat pool.
Branch-wise pay is not in the NIRF sheets we read. Do not trust a branch pay table that names no sample.
A top-college core branch and a newer-college computer science seat are a real trade. See the next section.
Rung 4. Computer science at the newer IITs (Ropar to Bhilai)
JEE Advanced rank
Round 5, 2026: Ropar 3,214, Mandi 3,762, Dhanbad 4,167, Bhubaneswar 4,899, Tirupati 6,030, Goa 7,024, Jammu 7,218, Palakkad 7,625, Dharwad 8,332, Bhilai 8,886.
Same IIT seat pool. Bhilai closed at a rank 133 times larger than Bombay.
No NIRF sheet read for these. Check the placed share and the "neither" count yourself.
Small, young campuses can have uneven placements. Read the last two batches, not the brochure.
Rung 5. NIT computer science and core branches
JEE Main rank
JoSAA 2026, round 5, other-state open: Trichy CSE 1,373, Warangal CSE 2,581. Surathkal CSE in 2025: 1,827 other-state, 2,800 home-state.
25,162 NIT seats in 2026. No Advanced needed.
NIRF 2025 median of the placed: NIT Trichy Rs 14.35 lakh, NIT Jamshedpur Rs 10.8 lakh, NIT Patna Rs 7.0 lakh. NIT Andhra Pradesh Rs 6.41 lakh in the 2025 batch.
At Surathkal in 2025 the home-state close was nearly 1,000 ranks looser than other-state. Check which quota you hold.
Rung 6. IIIT and other government-funded technical institute (GFTI) seats through JoSAA
JEE Main rank
We did not collect closing ranks for these. Read your own category table on the JoSAA site.
11,518 IIIT seats and 11,692 GFTI seats, so 23,210 together.
Check each institute, since some are strong and some are thin.
Do not rank a seat by the word "IIIT" or "NIT" in its name. Rank it by its own placed share and median.

blocks.heading: Popular PCM Claims Vs the Record
rows: "JoSAA is how you get into engineering."
JoSAA offered 67,323 seats in 2026. AICTE counted about 12.53 lakh B.Tech admissions in 2024-25. JoSAA is about 5.4% of that.
"You need JEE Advanced for a good engineering seat."
48,372 of 67,323 JoSAA seats (71.9%) need only a JEE Main rank. IIT seats are 18,951.
"B.Arch needs 50% in Class 12 PCM."
The NATA 2026 brochure from the Council of Architecture asks for at least 45% aggregate, with Physics and Maths compulsory.
"India produces over 1.5 million engineers every year."
One ranking page says this with no source. AICTE approved about 14.9 lakh seats and counted about 12.53 lakh admissions in 2024-25. The 15 lakh looks like seats, not graduates.
"Cybersecurity analyst: Rs 8.3 to 35.9 lakh."
A 4.3 times spread with no sample size or year. We print no pay range that names no sample.
A headline "placement percentage" on a college page.
NIRF sheets show the share placed, the share in higher studies and the rest. At Sathyabama 39.2% were neither, and at IIT Delhi 19.7%.

blocks.heading: Career Options After JEE
rows: Qualified Advanced, no IIT seat
Use the same JoSAA process for NIT, IIIT and GFTI seats on your Main rank. Keep IISc BS, IISER and BITSAT dates in view.
Do not cancel a seat yourself. JoSAA says doing so is treated as a rejection and removes you from the process.
IIT seat, weak branch
Compare it with a stronger branch at a good NIT using the NIRF sheet. If you stay, add the skill the branch lacks, such as coding, data or automation, and show one project.
A withdrawn IIT seat costs Rs 7,000 in processing charges under the 2026 rules and ends your JoSAA run, so decide before you withdraw.
Thinking of studying abroad
Price the full cost first. Compare it with a debt-light seat in India plus a year of skill building.
Repayment that depends on a visa, a foreign job or an exchange rate is a high-risk loan.

blocks.heading: Multiplier Skill for Each Rung
rows: Computer science, top rungs (IIT, NIT, BITS)
A public repository with real commits, one deployed project, and a short write-up of a bug you fixed.
Clear writing and talking to a non-engineer about a problem.
Now: AI helps draft code and tests, which you must read and run. Later: routine code shrinks, so system design and debugging carry the pay.
Computer science, other rungs (state and private)
Two shipped projects, one internship or freelance task with a result, and a one-page case note.
One adjacent domain, such as finance, health or logistics.
Now: build faster with AI help and show how you checked it. Later: entry-level production roles are the crowded part, so a domain edge matters.
Core branches (Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, Electronics)
A drawing set, a model or a site report, plus one software skill such as CAD, simulation or data in a spreadsheet.
Basic programming and cost estimates.
Now: AI speeds first-pass analysis and documents. Later: routine drafting shrinks, so site judgment and safety calls stay valuable.
Not engineering (science, design, defence, architecture)
A portfolio, a data project, a fitness log or a medical, matched to the door.
Explaining your work in plain words, in two languages if you can.
Now: research and drafting help. Later: judgment, taste and accountable decisions hold their value. See the separate guide for each door.
